# INV001: invariant-without-anchor

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | INV |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | warn |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

An invariants document has no `frob:invariant` directive in code.

Each `invariants/<slug>.md` file must be upheld somewhere: a
`frob:invariant <slug>` directive (slug is the file stem) in code or tests
anchors it. Add the directive where the invariant is enforced, or remove the
document.

## Examples

### INV001 invariants without an anchor / Fires on an unanchored invariant document #1 (line 6) (fire)

<!-- frob:waive DOC004 reason="generated example copied from the rule's test corpus" -->
```markdown
# No double commit <!-- warn: INV001 -->

Nothing anchors this claim.
```
